title: MCP tools: stage_move_selection, scene_reorder, stage_find_instances, library_use_count
description:
Add 4 new MCP tools that expose recently-added JSFL methods:

1. stage_move_selection: moves selected objects by a delta. Params: dx (number), dy (number). Calls doc.moveSelectionBy({x:dx, y:dy}) via JSFL or the equivalent core mutation directly. Use the same pattern as stage_update.

2. scene_reorder: reorders a scene. Params: sceneIndex (number, 0-based scene to move), insertBefore (number, 0-based position to insert before). Calls coreReorderScenes or doc.reorderScene(). Look at scene_duplicate as a structural template.

3. stage_find_instances: finds all instances of a named library symbol on stage. Params: symbolName (string). Returns { instances: Array<{id, x, y, layerIndex, frameIndex}> }. Iterates scenes/layers/keyframes like the JSFL findSymbolInstances implementation.

4. library_use_count: returns the usage count for a library item. Params: name (string). Returns { count: number }. Can either call the JSFL library.useCount() or implement directly by counting SymbolInstances matching the symbol's id.

Files to modify:
- packages/agent-protocol/src/index.ts — add schemas and types for each tool
- packages/vite-plugin-agent-mcp/src/index.ts — register the tools
- packages/authoring-ui/src/agent/registry.ts — implement handlers

Use timeline_copy_frames and scene_duplicate as structural templates.
